note: Equipment archetypes of Erdae. `base` holds the per-piece stats of the baseline variant `b` (soft attack sa, hard attack ha, defence def, breakthrough brk, piercing ap, armour arm, hardness hard, air attack air). Variant n has stats base x (1 + g.x (n - b)) (x = sa, ha, def, brk), piercing + apStep (n - b), armour + armStep (n - b) and build cost x (1 + 0.08 (n - b)); a variant row may override any stat with `set`. `res` uses engine resource keys (steel Iron, aluminium Timber, rubber Horses, tungsten Stone, chromium Gold, oil Essence; docs/specs/03_gameplay/02_economy.md); `resLate` adds resources from variant `from`. `prod` lists who can produce it: a people key, or `country:<name>`; an empty list means nobody (granted). Every equipment burns no fuel.

land.name: Arms
land.desc: Spears, swords, axes and shields, forged by the smiths of every realm.

variants.name: Iron-Shod Spears
variants.desc: Plain spears, short swords and round shields.

variants.name: Forged Blades
variants.desc: Blades folded and hammered until they hold an edge.

variants.name: Tempered Blades
variants.desc: Quenched in water and drawn back in the fire.

variants.name: Pattern-Welded Blades
variants.desc: Twisted rods forged into one blade, strong and supple.

variants.name: Master-Forged Arms
variants.desc: Arms from the great forges, made to a master's pattern.

variants.name: Mountain-Iron Arms
variants.desc: Blades of the hard iron of the high mines.

land.name: Bows and Crossbows
land.desc: Hunting bows, longbows and crossbows, made by the bowyers.

variants.name: Hunting Bows
variants.desc: Short bows of ash and horn.

variants.name: Composite Bows
variants.desc: Bows of horn, wood and sinew, glued in layers.

variants.name: War Longbows
variants.desc: Tall yew bows drawn by trained arms.

variants.name: Crossbows
variants.desc: Bows on stocks that throw a heavy bolt through mail.

variants.name: Windlass Crossbows
variants.desc: Crossbows spanned with a windlass, slow to load and very strong.

land.name: Mail and Plate
land.desc: Mail shirts, helms and plate harness for the men who stand in front.

variants.name: Mail Shirts
variants.desc: Riveted rings that turn a cut.

variants.name: Plate and Mail
variants.desc: Mail with plates over chest and thigh.

variants.name: Full Plate
variants.desc: A full harness of plate, close fitted.

variants.name: Tempered Plate
variants.desc: Plate hardened in oil and proved with a crossbow.

variants.name: Masterwork Plate
variants.desc: The finest harness the master smiths can make.

land.name: War Mounts
land.desc: Horses, camels and other beasts trained to carry a rider into battle.

variants.name: Riding Horses
variants.desc: Sound riding horses and steady camels.

variants.name: War Horses
variants.desc: Heavy horses bred to carry a mailed rider.

variants.name: Great Studs
variants.desc: Stud-bred stallions of great size and nerve.

variants.name: Plains Destriers
variants.desc: The great horses of the plains, fast and tireless.

land.name: Elven Arms
land.desc: Swords, spears and longbows of the elven smiths, light and keen.

variants.name: Elven Blades
variants.desc: Blades and bows of an older craft.

variants.name: Leaf-Edged Arms
variants.desc: Long blades and longbows, thin and bright.

variants.name: Leaf-Forged Arms
variants.desc: Arms forged under the trees, a song to each blade.

variants.name: Song-Forged Arms
variants.desc: Arms whose edge was sung, not hammered.

land.name: Camp Gear
land.desc: Tools, tents, horns and the healers' kits that follow a host.

variants.name: Camp Gear
variants.desc: Spades, axes, tents, horns and healers' kits.

land.name: Wards
land.desc: Lantern-glass, hallowed tokens and wardsong, carried to the front by those who know the rites.

variants.name: Lantern Glass
variants.desc: Glass lanterns that burn with a pale flame.

variants.name: Hallowed Tokens
variants.desc: Tokens blessed at the turn of the seasons.

variants.name: Close-Set Wards
variants.desc: Wards set so close that no gap opens between them.

variants.name: Wards Against Death
variants.desc: The strongest wards the rites allow, bright enough to unmake what ought to lie still.

land.name: Catapults
land.desc: Torsion catapults that throw stone shot and fire-pots.

variants.name: Light Catapults
variants.desc: Simple arm-and-sling engines.

variants.name: Torsion Catapults
variants.desc: Twisted-cord engines that throw a heavy stone.

variants.name: Great Catapults
variants.desc: Engines of the great pattern, with long arms and iron frames.

variants.name: Master Catapults
variants.desc: The best engines the lodges can build.

land.name: Trebuchets
land.desc: Counterweight engines that throw a great stone a long way.

variants.name: Counterweight Trebuchets
variants.desc: A long arm, a sling and a box of stones.

variants.name: Great Trebuchets
variants.desc: Trebuchets of the great pattern, with a heavier weight.

variants.name: Master Trebuchets
variants.desc: Engines that throw a stone through a curtain wall.

land.name: Ballistae
land.desc: Great bolt-throwers whose iron-shod bolts pierce hide and plate.

variants.name: Bolt-Throwers
variants.desc: Heavy bows on frames, set to pierce.

variants.name: Great Ballistae
variants.desc: Ballistae with twin arms and iron-shod bolts.

variants.name: Master Ballistae
variants.desc: The surest answer to a charging monster.

land.name: Scorpions
land.desc: Light bolt-throwers on wheeled frames, set to shoot upward.

variants.name: Scorpions
variants.desc: Swivel bolt-throwers that watch the sky.

variants.name: Master Scorpions
variants.desc: Scorpions with a longer reach and a steadier aim.

land.name: Troll Gear
land.desc: Iron-bound clubs and hide plates cut for troll limbs.

variants.name: Iron-Bound Clubs
variants.desc: Great clubs of oak ringed with iron, and hide plates.

variants.name: Troll Harness
variants.desc: Boiled hide and riveted plates on the troll frame.

variants.name: Troll War-Plate
variants.desc: Heavy plate beaten for the largest brood-lords.

land.name: Giant Gear
land.desc: Great weapons, slings and straps sized for giants.

variants.name: Great Weapons
variants.desc: Tree-trunk clubs, great axes and slings of rope.

variants.name: Giant Harness
variants.desc: Plates and straps made for a giant's reach.

variants.name: Giant War-Gear
variants.desc: The heavy gear of the oldest giant houses.

land.name: Grove Wardings
land.desc: The care of the moot: bark, sap and stone that keep an ent whole.

variants.name: Grove Wardings
variants.desc: The moot's old wardings, cut into bark and root.

variants.name: Deep Roots
variants.desc: Wardings that reach down to the old rock.

variants.name: Heartwood
variants.desc: Wardings sung into the heartwood itself.

land.name: Yeti Gear
land.desc: Spears, clubs and bone plates of the frozen north.

variants.name: Bone and Hide
variants.desc: Spears of bone and plates of cured hide.

variants.name: Ice-Hardened Gear
variants.desc: Gear hardened in the deepest frost.

variants.name: Glacier Plate
variants.desc: Heavy plates beaten from cold iron.

land.name: Ogre Gear
land.desc: Great iron-bound clubs and chain for ogres.

variants.name: Ogre Clubs
variants.desc: Iron-bound clubs and heaps of chain.

variants.name: Ogre Harness
variants.desc: Chain and plate riveted to fit an ogre.

variants.name: Ogre War-Plate
variants.desc: Thick plate made in the orc forges.

land.name: Grave Arms
land.desc: Rusted blades and bone-edged spears bound to the dead by rite.

variants.name: Grave Blades
variants.desc: Old blades, taken from the barrows and bound again.

variants.name: Rimed Blades
variants.desc: Blades rimed with grave-frost, cold in the hand.

variants.name: Bone-Edged Arms
variants.desc: Arms edged with bone and bound by deeper rites.

land.name: Nether Arms
land.desc: Black iron blades and hooked spears from the deep forges.

variants.name: Nether Blades
variants.desc: Hooked blades from the deep halls.

variants.name: Black Iron Arms
variants.desc: Arms of black iron, hard and cold.

variants.name: Nether-Forged Arms
variants.desc: Arms forged where the flame burns cold.

land.name: Deathless Bonds
land.desc: The will that holds a fallen body upright. Zol's alone; it cannot be made, only given.

variants.name: Bonds of the First Tide
variants.desc: The first tide of the Mistake's power.

variants.name: Bonds of the Second Tide
variants.desc: A stronger tide, a firmer hold.

variants.name: Bonds of the Third Tide
variants.desc: The third tide, at its height.

land.name: Shachihata
land.desc: A great demon of fire and horn. It cannot be made; it can only be given.

variants.name: A Shachihata
variants.desc: A great demon of fire and horn.

land.name: The Bearer of Glo
land.desc: The great light, carried in a bearer's hand. It cannot be made or traded.

variants.name: Glo, Whole
variants.desc: The light of Glo at its full strength.

variants.name: Glo, Shard
variants.desc: What the light keeps after the blade was broken. It still wounds the greatest of the dead.

land.name: Volgan's Presence
land.desc: The Lord of the Dead Lands in the field. It cannot be made or traded.

variants.name: Volgan's Presence
variants.desc: The Lord of the Dead Lands in the field.

land.name: A Great Spirit
land.desc: An old spirit bound to a host. It cannot be made or traded.

variants.name: A Great Spirit
variants.desc: An old spirit bound to the host.

land.name: Zol Made Flesh
land.desc: Zol shown to the field. It cannot be made, traded or kept.

variants.name: Zol Made Flesh
variants.desc: Zol shown to the field.

logistics.name: Pack Trains
logistics.desc: Strings of pack beasts and carts that serve the depots.

variants.name: Mule Strings
variants.desc: Mules and ponies in long strings.

variants.name: Waggon Strings
variants.desc: Strong carts drawn by teams.

variants.name: Great Depot Trains
variants.desc: Heavy waggons on the high roads.

logistics.name: Wagon Trains
logistics.desc: Long trains of wagons on the high roads.

variants.name: Plain Wagon Train
variants.desc: Heavy wagons on rutted roads.

variants.name: High Road Wagon Train
variants.desc: Wagons built for the paved high roads.

logistics.name: Merchant Fleets
logistics.desc: Fleets of broad merchant cogs that carry trade, supply and landings.

variants.name: Merchant Cog
variants.desc: A broad single-masted cog for coasts and rivers.

variants.name: Ocean Cog
variants.desc: A deep cog built to cross the wide sea.

air.name: Griffins
air.desc: Bred griffins trained to carry a rider and fight in the air.

variants.name: Eyrie-Bred Griffins
variants.desc: Griffins raised from the egg in a man-made eyrie.

variants.name: Harnessed Griffins
variants.desc: Griffins fitted with a strong riding harness.

variants.name: Lance Griffins
variants.desc: Griffins and riders trained to charge with lances.

air.name: Dragons
air.desc: A dragon of the old mountain, lent to a realm by pact. It cannot be built, bought or replaced.

variants.name: A Dragon
variants.desc: A dragon of the old mountain.
